title: Broadcasts fan out → scope by identifier
trigger: Broadcast message reaches every listener but only one should act
principle: Broadcast primitives cannot target a specific listener — they fan out to all. Scope by embedding an identifier in the payload; each listener filters by matching that identifier against its own context.

cases.context: Popup for tab A renders media from tab B because update broadcasts reach every popup listener
Handler falls back to all-tab media when requested tab is empty, compounding the leak
cases.bad:
// fallback returns media from ANY tab when active tab empty
const media = tabMedia[tabId] ?? allTabMedia;

applyFor: WebSocket rooms where server broadcasts to all and client filters by roomId
Event emitters where emit reaches all listeners and filter by event type/payload
Any fan-out channel needing per-recipient scoping via payload identifier
